jobs.title: Implementation Project Manager
jobs.description:
**THE COMPANY**
===============

At Builder Prime, we’re revolutionizing the home improvement industry by doing more than just building software—we're giving hardworking contractors their time and freedom back. Our all-in-one business management solution is the essential platform for companies at their "level-up" moment, seamlessly integrating CRM, estimating, production management, payments, and reporting. By replacing disjointed tools with a unified data and automation foundation, we empower businesses to operate more efficiently, win more jobs, and achieve their growth goals. We look for collaborative and community-oriented team members who bring initiative and curiosity to the challenge of solving problems for our customers.

Builder Prime is backed by Blueprint Equity and is an AI-forward company. That means every employee is expected to use AI on real problems—not hypotheticals, not demos, but the actual work on their desk. We invest in tools, training, and time for our team to experiment and share what they learn. We’re not waiting on the sidelines, and we don’t have it all figured out. We’re building this practice alongside our team, in the open.

We look for collaborative, community-oriented team members who bring initiative, curiosity, and a genuine interest in figuring out how AI can make their work and their customers’ outcomes better.

**THE ROLE**
============

**This is a remote position open to candidates authorized to work in the US without visa sponsorship, who presently reside in the US.** *There is a preference for candidates in states where we already have Builder Prime employees; California, Colorado, Florida, Georgia, Idaho, Indiana, Nebraska, New York, Ohio, Oregon, Texas, Utah, Virginia, Washington, and Wisconsin. Builder Prime has an office in the greater Denver metro area (Westminster) that some of the sales team works out of.*

Our implementation team facilitates smooth transitions for new customers by providing personalized implementation plans, technical configuration assistance, and comprehensive training to ensure effective software adoption and swift time to value.

As a member of the implementation team, you will lead implementations and drive strategic improvements to our implementation methodology. You'll serve as the escalation point for challenging technical configurations and will be instrumental in reducing our overall customer onboarding timeline.

**THE DAY-TO-DAY**
==================

As an Implementation Project Manager at Builder Prime, you are responsible for guiding new customers through the implementation process, ensuring they achieve rapid time-to-value from our platform. This role reports directly to the Manager of Implementation and collaborates closely with Account Managers, Support, and Sales.

* Drive strategic initiatives to streamline implementation processes and reduce time-to-value
* Manage implementations with multiple stakeholders and complex technical requirements
* Lead kickoff calls to understand customer goals, timeline expectations, and success metrics
* Configure the platform with custom templates, workflows, and settings specific to each customer's needs
* Prepare customers for post-implementation self-sufficiency by delivering system training as part of the Implementation process.
* Track implementation milestones and manage customer expectations throughout the setup process
* Identify and solve technical challenges that arise during implementation
* Coordinate with Account Managers for a smooth handoff once implementation is complete
* Document customer workflows and configurations for future reference and support
* Continuously optimize implementation processes to improve efficiency and customer satisfaction
* Analyze implementation data to identify bottlenecks and recommend process improvements
* Participate in cross-functional projects aimed at improving customer onboarding experience

**THE MUST-HAVES**
==================

* 3+ years of experience in customer onboarding, implementation, or training roles, preferably in SaaS or construction technology
* Demonstrated ability to translate technical product capabilities into business value for diverse customer workflows
* Proven track record of reducing implementation timelines and improving customer satisfaction scores
* Experience with implementations involving multiple stakeholders and complex integrations
* Strong analytical skills with ability to use data to drive process improvements
* Experience conducting engaging virtual training sessions
* Strong technical configuration skills with the ability to learn and master new software platforms quickly
* Excellent project management abilities with a track record of meeting implementation deadlines
* Exceptional communication skills, including the ability to adapt messaging to different learning styles

**THE NICE-TO-HAVES**
=====================

* Knowledge or experience in SaaS and the home improvement industry.
* Strong understanding of business management CRM software and its application in improving business processes.

**THE BENEFITS**
================

**Why You'll Love Working Here:**

* **Exceptional Health Coverage** – We cover 95% of medical, dental, and vision premiums for employees (Aetna & Guardian), plus 50% for dependents
* **Strong Retirement Match** – 401k with up to 4% company match that's immediately vested (no waiting period!)
* **Generous Time Off** – 20 PTO days, 48 hours sick time, 9 paid holidays, plus a paid volunteer day to give back to your community
* **Annual International Retreat** – All-expenses-paid company trip to connect with teammates in amazing destinations (This year we went to Cancun, Mexico! Join us for our next one in 2027)
* **Life Happens Coverage** – Company-paid life insurance ($50k), AD&D, and short-term disability, plus optional accident, hospital, critical illness, and additional life insurance
* **Grow With Us** – $300 annual professional development stipend, plus an incredible sabbatical at 5 years (2 extra weeks PTO + $1,000 travel bonus)
* **Comprehensive Parental Leave** – 10 weeks paid parental leave for birthing parents, 4 weeks for non-birthing parents
* **Fully Equipped From Day One** – Company-provided laptop and all the equipment you need to succeed

**This position will pay a base salary of $65,000-$75,000 depending on experience and location.**

*Builder Prime is an Equal Opportunity Employer and values diversity at all levels. We also participate in E-Verify to confirm employment eligibility in the U.S.*

Compensation Range: $65K - $75K

jobs.title: Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
**Implementation Specialist**

*This role is full-time and remote in the USA.*

The **Implementation Specialist** (IS) leads clients through their ELC (Experiential Learning Cloud) onboarding journey, serving as the primary day-to-day point of contact from Kickoff Meeting through launch. They guide each institution through critical stages from kickoff and database setup through coaching transition and go-live, ensuring customers successfully adopt the platform and realize its value. The Implementation Specialist coordinates across internal teams (Support, Account Management), manages stakeholder expectations, and proactively identifies risks that could derail the implementation. They combine project management discipline with customer empathy, translating complex product features into practical workflows aligned to each client's unique needs.

**Responsibilities**

**Implementation Leadership & Project Management**

* Own the end-to-end onboarding timeline for multiple, simultaneous customer implementations, tracking progress through all stages of the implementation checklist
* Schedule and facilitate kickoff meetings, initial setup reviews, database review sessions, and coaching transitions ensuring all parties are aligned and informed
* Set and manage realistic go-live dates with customers, accounting for their availability, complexity, and dependencies; flag timeline risks early

**Customer Relationship & Communication**

* Serve as the customer's first and primary point of contact from initial kickoff through go-live, building trust and confidence in the onboarding process
* Translate customer goals and constraints into implementation scope, making trade-off recommendations when needed
* Deliver clear, regular status updates both internally and to customers highlighting progress, risks, and next steps in plain language
* Identify and escalate customer frustrations, adoption blockers, or engagement gaps before they jeopardize the implementation

**Coordination & Problem-Solving**

* Coordinate with Product and Support teams on questions, feature requests, or technical issues that arise during implementation
* Collaborate with Account Management on renewal planning and expansion opportunities post-launch
* Manage scope and expectations, protecting the implementation timeline from scope creep while advocating for reasonable customer needs

**Database Design & Technical Oversight**

* Work with Product and customers to design the ELC database structure (student groups, placement workflows, field experience bundles) that aligns to their program's processes
* Set up and create elements of client’s database
* Conduct database reviews with customers to validate the build against their requirements and best practices
* Understand core ELC functionality (site placement, groups and assignments, data management, integrations) at a level needed to advise customers and coordinate technical setup

**Documentation & Knowledge Management**

* Document each customer's unique configuration, go-live date, key stakeholders, and any special requirements in Jira and supporting systems
* Create or customize onboarding templates to reflect current best practices
* Contribute feedback from customer implementations to continuously improve the onboarding process

**Required Qualifications & Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Education, Business Administration, Project Management, or a related field; or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience
* 2-4 years in project management, customer success, or implementation roles in SaaS or EdTech with experience onboarding higher education institutions strongly preferred
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple complex projects simultaneously while maintaining attention to detail and customer relationships
* Strong organizational and time-management skills; comfort with tools like Jira, spreadsheets, and project timelines
* Excellent verbal and written communication; ability to translate technical concepts for non-technical audiences
* Problem-solver and self-starter who takes ownership of challenges and collaborates across teams to resolve them
* Comfort with ambiguity and changing priorities; adaptability in a growing organization

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in higher education, EdTech, or non-profit sectors
* Familiarity with instructional design, experiential learning, or field experience program models
* Experience with Atlassian tools (Jira, Confluence) or similar project management platforms
* Background in software implementation, data migration, or system integration projects
* Project Management certification (PMP, CAPM, or similar)

**The Essentials**

* Fully remote in the USA. We provide all necessary equipment and a monthly tech stipend for your home office
* A global team with local connections. Work with talented Lumiverians worldwide
* Visa sponsorship is not available for this role. Lumivero participates in E-Verify. All offers are contingent upon successful confirmation of employment eligibility

**Compensation + Benefits**

* Base salary is $60,000-$70,000 with eligibility to earn a performance-based annual bonus
* Benefits package including generous company contribution for major medical, dental, and vision insurance with HSA and FSA options available
* Additional insurance coverage including long and short-term disability coverage, life insurance, and voluntary insurance options
* Roth and Traditional 401(k) options with a generous match, vested immediately
* Technology stipend to keep your home office running
* Flexible time off, 11 holidays, and paid sick time
* Company paid parental leave policies

**Who we are**

Lumivero empowers researchers, industry experts, and business leaders to simplify data complexity, find insights, and get clarity through human expertise, trusted data, and intelligent agents. We pair expert-built, rigorous methodology with powerful data analysis and AI-driven workflows so the people making high-stakes calls can make them with confidence.

It's trusted at serious scale. Our solutions include the #1 probabilistic risk software, the #1 QDA software, and the most cited software in their fields. More than 27,000 organizations worldwide rely on Lumivero — including around 90% of the Fortune 100 — across energy, financial services, government, defense, and manufacturing.

*Please note that this employer uses an automated AI resume screening tool as part of the application review process. This tool analyzes resumes against job requirements to help identify well-suited candidates based on skills, education, and relevant experience. However, human recruiters and hiring managers remain actively involved throughout the process — they review applications, exercise independent judgment, and make all final shortlisting and hiring decisions.*

jobs.title: Recruiter/Onboarding Specialist
jobs.description:
About AnswerNet

AnswerNet is the brand name for the AnswerNet family of companies including AnswerNet, Inc., New AnswerNet Inc., Cerida Investment Corp., ECC (Energy Choice California), Synergy Solutions, TPV.com, and Ansercomm to name a few. Together with our affiliates, AnswerNet operates more than 20 contact centers within the continental United States and Canada. We provide a vast range of services to optimize telephone answering services, appointment setting and confirmation, customer support, third-party verification, sales, lead qualification, market research, and a host of other contact management solutions. In all, AnswerNet has more than 10,000 satisfied clients and we process over 125 million interactions per year.

  

Job Summary:

We are seeking a proactive, detail-oriented Recruiter & Onboarding Specialist to manage full-lifecycle talent acquisition and candidate onboarding for our growing remote workforce. In this role, you will be primarily responsible for sourcing, vetting, and onboarding high-volume Technical Support Representatives (TSRs) who provide front-line technical support, account billing assistance, and network troubleshooting for wireless telecommunications subscribers operating on major nationwide networks.

In addition to core talent acquisition and onboarding duties, you will collaborate closely with our Marketing Team to enhance employer branding and execute recruitment campaigns across social media channels (LinkedIn, Facebook, X, Instagram) to engage qualified, tech-savvy applicants.

* **Core Responsibilities**

* **Talent Acquisition & High-Volume Sourcing**

* **High-Volume Technical Sourcing:** Manage active talent pipelines to recruit Technical Support Representatives capable of handling softphone inbound/outbound calls, website navigation, warranty handling, and subscriber de-escalation.
* **Pre-Hire Evaluation & Assessment:** Administer and score pre-hire assessments evaluating baseline competency in typing speed, grammar, spelling, listening comprehension, and customer empathy.
* **Shift & Operational Availability Alignment:** Screen candidates to ensure complete availability for 40-hour weekly full-time schedules across the client’s operational hours.

* **Candidate Onboarding & Compliance Management**

* **Full Onboarding Lifecycle:** Guide candidates seamlessly from contingent offer acceptance through background checks, compliance documentation, company onboarding within the HRIS system, and day-one training launch, maintaining active communication to eliminate drop-offs.
* **Background Vetting:** Initiate and review mandatory 7-year background checks to ensure compliance with company and client security standards.
* **Training Class Readiness:** Collaborate with Operations and Training leads to ensure 100% candidate show-up rates and technical readiness for paid training cohorts.

* **Recruitment Marketing & Social Media Collaboration**

* **Marketing Alignment:** Partner with the Marketing Department to align recruitment messaging, visual assets, and employer branding with company standards.
* **Social Media Campaign Execution:** Assist in drafting, scheduling, and publishing recruitment post copy, job announcements, and visual banners across social media platforms (LinkedIn, Facebook, X, Instagram).
* **Applicant Engagement:** Monitor social channel responses, direct messages, and comments to actively convert passive interest into active applicant submissions.

* **Technical Workspace & Hardware Vetting Standards**

* Auditing candidate home equipment against non-negotiable technical requirements prior to extending offers.

* **Candidate Qualifications**

* **Recruitment & Onboarding Experience:** 2+ years of experience in full-lifecycle recruiting and onboarding, preferably in high-volume call center, customer service, or remote technical support environments.
* **Technical Workspace Auditing Skills:** Ability to verify candidate home hardware specifications, interpret remote internet speed test results, and evaluate hardware compatibility.
* **Social Media & Recruitment Marketing:** Demonstrated experience posting job openings on social media platforms, writing engaging candidate-facing copy, and partnering with marketing teams.
* **Education:** High School Diploma or equivalent required.
* **Required equipment:** A Windows PC is required, running Windows 10 or 11 (no MacBooks or Chromebooks or virtual machines), 8 GB of RAM, Quad-core processor, Wired internet connection with a minimum internet speed of 80/15 (Cannot use satellite, hotspots, MIFI devices, wireless AC wall plug-in extenders, repeaters, boosters, and/or pods), and Dual Monitors.
* Other requirements may vary as determined by management.

* **System & Tool Preferred Proficiencies**

* **Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS):** Hands-on experience managing candidate workflows in platforms such as UKG.
* **Recruitment Marketing & Graphic Tools:** Familiarity with social scheduling and visual design applications (e.g., Canva, Adobe Express) for creating recruitment media.
* **Industry & Domain Knowledge:** Prior experience sourcing talent within telecommunications, MVNO wireless services, or AI-assisted contact center environments.
* **Assessment Platforms:** Experience with pre-employment testing suites (e.g., Test Gorilla).
* **Background Check Platforms:** Experience with pre-employment background checking services (e.g., Checkr, Accurate).
* **SaaS Suites:** Cloud-based productivity and collaboration suites delivered via SaaS (e.g., Google Workspace, Microsoft 365).

Equal Opportunity Employer  
This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

jobs.title: Project Manager - Customer Onboarding
jobs.description:
EnergyCAP, LLC is an industry-leading and award-winning software company focused on energy and sustainability management. EnergyCAP is trusted by 10,000+ Energy and Sustainability professionals across the country to be their single source of truth for financial-grade, actionable data to better manage resources, reduce carbon, and drive savings. If you’re looking for a role that enables you to do what you do best while making the future more sustainable, this is the role for you!

Our core values are: Accountability, Impact, Innovation, Integrity, and Teamwork.

Build a more sustainable future with us! Visit www.EnergyCAP.com to learn more.

**About the Role**

We're looking for a Project Manager to join our Onboarding & Implementation (O&I) team, where you'll take ownership of getting new customers (‘new logos’) up and running on E and lead expansion projects for existing customers as they grow their use of the platform.

You'll manage the full project lifecycle — from kickoff through a smooth handoff to the Customer Success team — driving toward fast, high-value implementations (typically within three to six months) and customer experiences strong enough to translate into great NPS scores and long-term product adoption. You'll bring an AI-forward mindset to how you run projects, using modern tools to work faster and smarter without sacrificing quality.

**What You'll Do**

* Take extreme ownership of assigned onboarding and implementation projects, managing them from kickoff through a smooth transition to the Customer Success team.
* Manage multiple projects of varying complexity simultaneously, following O&I methodology to control scope, schedule, and budget.
* Identify and apply methods to accelerate project timelines so customers realize value from EnergyCAP as quickly as possible.
* Delegate and coordinate work across project engineers and enrollment specialists to keep implementations moving and on track.
* Identify and work to meet each customer's defined Keys to Success and specified outcomes for their project.
* Configure EnergyCAP software and set up customer databases as defined in the Statement of Work for assigned projects.
* Proactively identify, assess, document, and mitigate risks to successful project completion.
* Conduct regular project status meetings — including agendas and minutes — and manage ongoing communication on work completed, work remaining, and risk mitigation plans.
* Effectively influence internal and external project team members, in person and remote, to keep projects moving toward shared goals.
* Provide online training to customers, plus occasional onsite training.
* Administer ‘mini’ premium success projects for existing customers — such as additional training or hourly support — as they expand their use of EnergyCAP.
* Support strategic O&I initiatives as assigned.

**What You'll Bring**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field.
* 1–2 years of project management experience, ideally at a software company or in an energy/sustainability-related environment.
* Experience implementing enterprise software and/or energy-related projects.
* Demonstrated experience building and using AI tools to improve efficiency and accelerate project execution.
* Comfort using basic Microsoft Excel functionality and formulas.
* Strong customer-facing experience, with the ability to influence and build trust with both internal and external stakeholders.
* Adaptable, organized, and self-motivated — a self-starter who pushes projects forward independently and as part of a collaborative team.

**Pay Range:** $70,000 - $90,000 annual salary with a 3% bonus.  
*Pay is commensurate with experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities.*

**Why You’ll Love Working Here**  
At EnergyCAP, we invest in you—personally, professionally, and beyond. Here’s how we support your growth, balance, and well-being:

**Health & Wellness**

* 100% company-paid Health, Dental & Vision coverage for you, plus competitive cost-sharing for your family
* Company-paid Life & LTD Insurance for peace of mind
* Adoption Grants and paid leave to support your growing family
* Wellness program offerings designed to strengthen your physical and mental health and overall well-being

**Financial Security**

* 401(k) with a 3% company match—helping you plan confidently for the future
* Monthly Connectivity Stipend so you can work seamlessly from anywhere

**Growth & Development**

* Emergenetics Development Program to help you understand and leverage your strengths
* Tuition Assistance to fuel your continued learning and career growth

❤️ **Community & Balance**

* Flexible Time Off so you can recharge and enjoy life outside of work
* A remote-first workplace that offers balance and flexibility, with the option to connect in-person at our offices
* Charitable contributions & matched giving to amplify your impact
* Paid community service hours—because giving back matters

At EnergyCAP, we don’t just offer benefits—we provide the tools, support, and flexibility you need to thrive in both work and life.

*EnergyCAP is a proud equal opportunity employer, committed to hiring and developing individuals from diverse background and experiences. We value and consider applications for all qualified candidates without regard to actual or perceived race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, age, marital status, personal appearance, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, family responsibilities, disability, medical condition, enrollment in college or vocational school, political affiliation, military or veteran status, citizenship status, genetic information, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law.*

*EnergyCAP will reasonably accommodate qualified individuals with disabilities in accordance with applicable law. If you are in need of an accommodation in order to submit your application, please email* *HR@energycap.com**.*

Please click HERE to view the mandatory Federal Applicant Laws that apply to your employment rights*.*

***Note******: We are currently not sponsoring VISAs.***

jobs.title: Implementation BI Solutions Consultant
jobs.description:
As a BI Solutions Consultant on our Implementation Team, you’ll play a pivotal role in shaping the future of business intelligence for leading organizations. This is your opportunity to work with innovative technologies and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. You’ll  
leverage your expertise in ERP systems and the Microsoft technology stack, including T-SQL coding and Power BI data modeling, to deliver high-impact solutions that empower our clients to make smarter, data-driven decisions.

In this role, you’ll also get hands-on experience with cutting-edge cloud Lakehouse environments, such as Databricks and Microsoft Fabric, enabling you to design and implement modern data architectures that drive scalability, performance, and advanced analytics capabilities.

  

**What** **You’ll** **Do**

* **Lead BI Implementations:** Install and configure the QuickLaunch product and Microsoft BI components, including SQL Database Views, Power BI Premium Datasets, Paginated Reports, and interactive Power BI dashboards.

* **Drive Client Success:** Conduct solution review sessions with customers and validate QuickLaunch  
  implementations.

* **Build Data Pipelines:** Configure ETL solutions using Databricks  
  or Microsoft Fabric  
  to enable efficient data integration and transformation.

* **Enable Analytics Excellence:** Create and secure Power BI workspaces and educate customers on best practices for content management and governance.

* **Deliver Exceptional Experiences:** Work directly with customers in a remote setting, prioritizing a positive, high-quality client experience at every step.

  

**Who You Are**

* 3+ years of experience working on Business Intelligence and Analytics related projects using Microsoft BI technologies

* In-depth knowledge of T-SQL, Microsoft BI Solutions including paginated reports, data models in Power  
  BI or SSAS Tabular Models

* Knowledge of JD Edwards, Viewpoint, OneStream, Salesforce, or other large complex ERP environments

* In-depth knowledge of reporting/business intelligence applications

* Experience using Pivot tables

* Problem-solving and communication skills, with the ability to express complex technical concepts in business terms

* Ability and desire to work in fast-paced, collaborative team environment

* Education – Bachelor’s degree required; Computer Science, MIS, Engineering, Business Administration, or related discipline is preferred, but not required

  

**Bonus Points**

* Exposure to ETL, ideally Databricks

* Familiarity with Microsoft Fabric Lakehouse, Microsoft Fabric Warehouse, and Microsoft Data Pipelines is a huge plus but not  
  required.

* Experience on the business side of reporting and analytics  
  (i.e. familiarity with income statements, balance sheets, or other financial statements)

  

**Working Location**: Remote OR in Santa Cruz County, CA office

**Compensation:** The estimated base salary range for this role is $100,000-130,000. There is also an opportunity for a discretionary bonus.

  

**About Us:**

At QuickLaunch Analytics our purpose is to simplify the often-complex world of data analytics. For over 20 years, we've helped 250+ companies make better decisions by delivering a comprehensive platform that centralizes and transforms data ecosystems into a unified enterprise-wide foundation for trusted information.

We're a team of 35+ professionals with deep expertise in Power BI, Databricks, and Azure Cloud. Our culture is built on ownership, collaboration, and continuous learning—reflected in our world-class Net Promoter Scores from both customers and team members.

If you're passionate about analytics and want to work with talented people who genuinely enjoy solving complex data challenges, we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager, Implementation
jobs.description:
Datavant is the data collaboration platform trusted for healthcare. Guided by our mission to make the world's health data secure, accessible and actionable, we provide critical data solutions for organizations across the healthcare ecosystem - including providers, health plans, researchers, and life sciences companies. From fulfilling a single patient's request for their medical records to powering the AI revolution in healthcare, Datavanters are building the future of how data is connected and used to improve health.  
  
By joining Datavant today, you're stepping onto a driven and highly collaborative team that is passionate about creating transformative change in healthcare.

The Senior Project Manager is responsible for independently managing complex, medium- to large-scale projects and programs throughout the full implementation lifecycle, from initiation and planning through go-live, stabilization, and handoff. Projects include implementation of new products and services associated with Release of Information. This role coordinates multiple concurrent initiatives and partners with other project managers, consultants, technical resources, business and IT teams, clients, and external vendors to define objectives, manage schedules and dependencies, monitor progress, and address risks and issues. The Senior Project Manager maintains effective governance, documentation, and communication practices to ensure consistent, high-quality delivery, timely implementation, and strong customer satisfaction.

### **You will:**

* **Project Oversight:** Independently manage assigned projects within the Project Management Tracking Tool, monitor progress, maintain accurate project records, and escalate schedule, scope, or delivery risks as appropriate.
* **Portfolio Accountability:** Maintain accountability for assigned projects and programs within the Client Impact portfolio, ensuring alignment with established objectives, timelines, and success measures.
* **Implementation Management:** Lead complex, large-scale, and high-profile implementation projects from initiation through stabilization and handoff.
* **Program Management:** Coordinate programs consisting of multiple related projects, partnering with the project managers responsible for individual workstreams to ensure alignment, dependency management, and successful overall delivery.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Partner with Datavant business teams, IT groups, clients, and external vendors to support the successful implementation of multiple concurrent projects and programs.
* **Quality Assurance:** Apply established project management methodologies and ensure assigned projects and programs produce accurate, consistent, and high-quality deliverables.
* **Customer Partnership:** Collaborate with Operations and customers to implement services and products that support customer satisfaction, retention, self-sufficiency, and profitability.
* **Risk and Issue Management:** Proactively identify, document, manage, and resolve project or program risks and issues, escalating matters to the appropriate leaders when necessary.
* **Communication and Reporting:** Facilitate recurring project and program meetings and provide clear, timely updates regarding status, milestones, risks, decisions, changes, and timelines.
* **Post-Implementation Support:** Coordinate post-go-live support, monitor stabilization activities, assist with issue resolution, and escalate concerns as necessary to support a successful transition to ongoing operations.

### **What you will bring to the table:**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Business Information Systems, Healthcare Administration, Project Management, or a related field; equivalent relevant professional experience may be considered.
* Minimum of five years of experience in project or program management and client-facing service delivery, with demonstrated success managing multiple concurrent projects or programs.
* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification is required.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Microsoft Project, Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Teams, as well as experience using project or portfolio management platforms.
* Proficiency in process development, continuous improvement, and problem-solving.
* Comprehensive understanding of Health Information Management within acute care, ambulatory, and clinic settings.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, negotiation, and influencing skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to manage competing priorities and perform effectively in a fast-paced environment.
* Ability to work independently, exercise sound judgment, and drive projects through completion.
* Experience developing and maintaining project roadmaps, schedules, and portfolio-level reporting.
* Strong presentation, meeting facilitation, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Demonstrated ability to lead complex projects, coordinate cross-functional resources, and support effective decision-making and planning.

To ensure the safety of patients and staff, many of our clients require post-offer health screenings and proof and/or completion of various vaccinations such as the flu shot, Tdap, COVID-19, etc. Any requests to be exempted from these requirements will be reviewed by Datavant Human Resources and determined on a case-by-case basis. Depending on the state in which you will be working, exemptions may be available on the basis of disability, medical contraindications to the vaccine or any of its components, pregnancy or pregnancy-related medical conditions, and/or religion.
  
  
This job is not eligible for employment sponsorship.  
  
Datavant is committed to a work environment free from job discrimination. We are proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, national origin, disability, veteran status, or other legally protected status. To learn more about our commitment, please review our EEO Commitment Statement here. Know Your Rights, explore the resources available through the EEOC for more information regarding your legal rights and protections. In addition, Datavant does not and will not discharge or in any other manner discriminate against employees or applicants because they have inquired about, discussed, or disclosed their own pay.  
  
At the end of this application, you will find a set of voluntary demographic questions. If you choose to respond, your answers will be anonymous and will help us identify areas for improvement in our recruitment process. (We can only see aggregate responses, not individual ones. In fact, we aren't even able to see whether you've responded.) Responding is entirely optional and will not affect your application or hiring process in any way.  
  
Datavant is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with physical and mental disabilities. If you need an accommodation while seeking employment, please request it here, by selecting the 'Interview Accommodation Request' category. You will need your requisition ID when submitting your request, you can find instructions for locating it here. Requests for reasonable accommodations will be reviewed on a case-by-case basis.

  

For more information about how we collect and use your data, please review our Privacy Policy.

jobs.title: Implementation Specialist I
jobs.description:
**Position Summary:**

Vallen's Implementation Specialist I is an individual contributor responsible for ensuring the deployment of IT systems and interfaces, the proper set up of storeroom operations and account infrastructures, the development of customer catalogs/data files, and physical inventory at Vallen's customer facilities. They provide initial go-live support and transition operations to site leadership post implementation of Vallen's business model.

**Essential Job Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Collaborates with customers to assist in defining their requirements for the implementation (e.g., data, performance reporting, delivery, freight, packaging, labeling, invoice payment, etc.).
* Assists IT in developing specifications for key interfaces, mapping data and assisting in testing to ensure reliability for a successful implementation and go-live.
* Assists with setting up account information in business system, linking the pricing matrix, ordering equipment, devising personnel/shift work flow logistics, identifying processes and conducting gap analysis with customer.
* Receives data files from customer and work under the supervision of the project leader to ensure all items are identified and cross referenced.
* Participates in the physical inventory activities at customer facilities by organizing stock, affixing bar code labels (if required) and counting inventory.
* Participates in post physical inventory processes by helping to reconcile variances with the customer's file.
* Provides go-live and transition support to site operations by conducting follow up training and site process review.
* Provides a level of excellent communication
* Performs other duties as assigned.

Requirements:

**Job Qualifications:**

Bachelor's degree and at least 1-3 years applicable experience; or an equivalent combination of education and experience that provides the knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform the job. Applicable experience should include:

* Working for a distributor of MRO products in sales, operations or purchasing
* Working in a manufacturing/production environment, preferably in the storeroom or tool crib
* Working in a purchasing/inventory management position in an industrial environment replenishing stock materials

Other relevant experience should include:

* Project Management knowledge; experience using Smartsheet preferred
* 6 Sigma Yellow or Green Belt Training
* Demonstrated knowledge of ISO Standards
* Demonstrated knowledge of QS9000 Quality Standards
* General knowledge of SAS, Excel, databases, Word, Power Point, and MS Project
* Ability to be a self starter and to self manage
* Solid organizational skills and strong customer service orientation
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills

**Work Environment & Physical Demands:**

(Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.):

* May have travel requirements with limited advance notice.
* Occasionally requires long and varied hours.
* Work environment may not be temperature controlled; must have the ability to work in extreme hot or cold environments.
* Must have the ability to work in dusty conditions.
* May be required to handle hazardous materials and wear various forms of protective equipment (shoes, gloves, protective eyewear, etc.)
* Must be able to handle and work physical inventory; required to lift up to 25 lbs or greater with assistance following standard operating and safety procedures. Other physical requirements including, regularly being required to stand, walk, kneel, bend, crouch, crawl, climb and balance.
* Close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and the ability to adjust focus are required.
* Must be able to follow detailed process.
* Must be able to Travel by Plane.
* Must be able to work in stressful situations.
* Vending Implementation or Operation Skills would be Helpful
